import argparse,base64,ctypes,json,subprocess,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path('tools/embeddinggemma2').resolve()))
import video_compare as v,compare
out=Path('/private/tmp/vision-discard-production-worker-probe.json')
a=argparse.Namespace(url=None,output=out,binary=Path('zig/zig-out/bin/antfly-inference-bench-server'),model_dir=Path('.benchmark-assets/native-video/model'),backend='metal',process_memory_budget_mb=4096,verify_capacity_retry=False)
c=v.corpus(Path('tools/embeddinggemma2/testdata/av1-layers/corpus.json'));rows=[]
def video(row):return {'model':'model','input':[{'content':[{'type':'media','mime_type':'video/webm','data':base64.b64encode(Path(row['path']).read_bytes()).decode()}]}]}
ctx=v.server(a)
with ctx as url:
 pid=ctx.gen.gi_frame.f_locals['process'].pid
 def workers():
  records={int(p):(int(pp),int(rss)) for p,pp,rss in (line.split() for line in subprocess.check_output(['ps','-axo','pid=,ppid=,rss='],text=True).splitlines())}
  pending=[pid];owned=set()
  while pending:
   parent=pending.pop();owned.add(parent);pending.extend(p for p,(pp,_) in records.items() if pp==parent and p not in owned)
  return max(owned,key=lambda p:records.get(p,(0,0))[1])
 def memory():
  worker=workers();raw=(ctypes.c_uint64*128)();rc=ctypes.CDLL('/usr/lib/libSystem.B.dylib').proc_pid_rusage(worker,4,ctypes.byref(raw))
  return {'pid':worker,'rc':rc,'resident_bytes':raw[8],'footprint_bytes':raw[9]}
 def record(label,body):
  before=v.metal_telemetry_snapshot(url);mem_before=memory()
  try:r=compare.post(url+'/ai/v1','/embed',body,timeout=600);result={'status':'pass','dimensions':len(r['data'][0]['embedding'])}
  except Exception as e:result=v.failure_details(e)
  after=v.metal_telemetry_snapshot(url);row={'label':label,'result':result,'telemetry':v.metal_telemetry_delta(before,after),'memory_before':mem_before,'memory_after':memory()};rows.append(row)
  print(label,str(result)[:700],row['memory_before'],row['memory_after'],flush=True);out.write_text(json.dumps({'scope':'Diagnostic, not qualification','pid':pid,'rows':rows},indent=2)+'\n')
 for q in c['queries']:record(q['id'],{'model':'model','input':[q['text']],'task_type':'RETRIEVAL_QUERY'})
 record('first_video',video(c['documents'][0]))
 with open('/private/tmp/vision-discard-production-worker-before.vmmap','w') as f:subprocess.run(['vmmap','-summary',str(workers())],stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 record('second_video',video(c['documents'][1]))
 with open('/private/tmp/vision-discard-production-worker-after.vmmap','w') as f:subprocess.run(['vmmap','-summary',str(workers())],stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 record('third_attempt',video(c['documents'][1]))
